children: Hong Kong, September 25, 2026-- Moody's Ratings has revised the outlook on Mongolian Mining Corporation to positive from stable. At the same time, we have affirmed the company's B2 corporate family rating and the B2 senior unsecured rating of the senior notes issued by MMC and its subsidiary Energy Resources LLC, and guaranteed by other key subsidiaries.

title: Moody's Ratings revises outlook on Mongolian Mining Corporation to positive from stable; affirms B2 ratings
